import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n = data[0]
lengths = data[1:1 + n]

positions = set()
pos = 0
for length in lengths:
    positions.add(pos)
    pos += length

if pos % 2:
    print("N")
else:
    half = pos // 2
    pairs = sum(1 for x in positions if (x + half) % pos in positions) // 2
    print("S" if pairs >= 2 else "N")
